```{r}
## Complete Pooling approach

# Make data object
run_data <- list(N = nrow(curling),
                 x = as.integer(curling$PowerPlay),
                 y = as.integer(curling$USWin),
                 z = curling$Points, 
                 m0 = 0,
                 m1 = 0,
                 m2 = 0,
                 s0 = 2,
                 s1 = 2,
                 s2 = 2)

# Fit model in Stan
fit <- stan(file = "C:\\Users\\wwh15\\Desktop\\STAT454 Bayes\\TR2\\techreport2-Bayes454\\completepooling.stan",
            data = run_data, 
            chains = 4, 
            warmup = 1000,
            iter = 2000)


```
